_comment: 示例（非正式答案）。自带内联数据，可直接跑通主命令：python3 scripts/chart.py --case examples/case.example.json --out /app/output。字段名故意混用常见别名（chart_type / y_label / y_unit / caption / journal / output_contract），用于说明容错读取；不是平台正式案例，也不含被测答案。
title: LPS-induced inflammatory gene expression (example data)
caption: Relative mRNA expression in BV2 cells treated with vehicle or LPS (100 ng/mL, 6 h). Bars are means of n = 3 independent cultures; error bars show s.d. * p < 0.05, two-tailed unpaired t-test. Example data, not a published result.
notes: Vehicle was normalised to 1.00 per gene, so comparisons are within a gene, not across genes.
